transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Carter, the S-3. Before I can publish the final staffing roster for the coordination cell during the four-day field exercise, we need to run our routine pre-exercise qualification scrub with personnel, logistics, and signal staff. We've got three desks to fill — partner liaison, POL accountability, and movement control — and three available personnel: Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega. Each desk requires a current applicable qualification. Let's start by confirming what qualifications each of these three soldiers currently holds, so we can match them to the right desks. Who has that information?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Maj. Carter. I can speak to Sgt Malik's qualifications. I confirmed in the personnel database this morning that Sgt Malik is the only one of the three available personnel with a current host-nation language qualification, which makes Malik the qualified choice for the partner-liaison desk. The renewal was confirmed today, though I should note the updated qualification export is not yet reflected on the S-3 briefing slide. I'll need to check with the others on Cpl Ortiz and Spc Vega's current qualifications for the POL accountability and movement control desks.
